notes: Default: the symbol of the current signature logo, taken from the BI page's img_bi_signature.svg (the first lockup's two symbol paths and their two linear gradients, unchanged): the b and flag in #FF6C00 -> #F25900 -> #DC3700 with the stem in #FF6C00 -> #FF9100, the page's Bithumb Orange Gradient. It is the symbol of Bithumb_Logo_Primary_KR_RGB.ai in the logo package (compared visually). It replaces the previous BI kit's flat #FF8200 b with a #D1350F flag, which the page no longer offers (bithumb_bi_asset.zip and the BI system guide v5.0 now return HTTP 404)

Mono: the symbol of the package's one-colour secondary logo (Bithumb_Logo_Secondary_White_KR_RGB.ai, converted with pdftocairo, path unchanged) in currentColor: the b with the flag as a separate sliver
brandColor: the page's primary colour Bithumb Orange #FF6C00 (RGB 255 108 0, PMS 1505 C)
